verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              ततः संशप्तका राजन् समे देशे व्यवस्थिताः।  व्यूह्यानीकं रथैरेव चन्द्राकारं मुदा युताः॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Then, O monarch, the Samsaptakas, filled with joy, stood on the level plain, having, with their chariots, formed an array figuring the moon.

verses.sanskrit: ते किरीटिनमायान्तं दृष्ट्वा हर्षेण मारिष।  उदक्रोशन्नरव्याघ्राः शब्देन महता तदा॥२॥
verses.english: O Sire, seeing the diadem-decked Arjuna rush at them, those foremost of men, highly delighted, gave out deafening roars.

verses.sanskrit: स शब्दः प्रदिशः सर्वा दिशः खं च समावृणोत्।  आवृतत्वाच्च लोकस्य नासीत् तत्र प्रतिस्वनः॥३॥
verses.english: Those roars filled the subsidiary and the cardinal quarters and also the conclave dome. There were produced no reverberations owing to the field being covered over with men.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽतीव संप्रहृष्टांस्तानुपलभ्य धनञ्जयः।  किंचिदभ्युत्स्मयन् कृष्णमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥४॥
verses.english: Then Dhananjaya, ascertaining them to be excessively delighted, said these words to Krishna, smiling the while.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यैतान् देवकीमातर्मुमूर्षूनद्य संयुगे।  भ्रातॄंस्त्रैगर्तकानेवं रोदितव्ये प्रहर्षितान्॥५॥
अथवा हर्षकालोऽयं त्रैगर्तानामसंशयम्।  कुनरैर्दुरवापान् हि लोकान् प्राप्स्यन्त्यनुत्तमान्॥६॥
verses.english: Or surely, this is the time for joy for the Trigarttas, as they shall, ere long, attain to those excellent regions which cannot be obtained by the cowards.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुहृषीकेशं ततोऽर्जुनः।  आससाद रणे व्यूढां त्रिगर्तानामनीकिनीम्॥७॥
verses.english: Having thus spoken to the mighty-armed Hrishikesha, Arjuna encountered in battle the ranks of the Trigartta soldiers disposed of in battle-array.

verses.sanskrit: स देवदत्तमादाय शंखं हेमपरिष्कृतम्।  दध्मौ वेगेन महता घोषणापूरयन् दिशः॥८॥
तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ता संशप्तकवरूथिनी।  विचेष्टाऽवस्थिता संख्ये ह्यश्मसारमयी यथा॥९॥
verses.english: Terrified at that blare, the car-host of the Samshaptakas stood motionless in the field of battle as if turned into adamant.

verses.sanskrit: वाहास्तेषां विवृत्ताक्षाः स्तब्धकर्णशिरोधराः।  विष्टब्धचरणा मूत्रं रुधिरं च प्रसुस्रुवुः॥१०॥
verses.english: All their steeds stood with their eyes expanded and their ears, necks and lips paralysed and their legs motionless, and they discharged urine and vomited blood.

verses.sanskrit: उपलभ्य ततः संज्ञामवस्थाप्य च वाहिनीम्।  युगपत् पाण्डुपुत्राय चिक्षिपुः कङ्कपत्रिणः॥११॥
तान्यर्जुनः सहस्राणि दशपञ्चभिराशुगैः।  अनागतान्येव शरैश्चिच्छेदाशु पराक्रमी॥१२॥
verses.english: Thereupon Arjuna, capable of manifesting with lightness his prowess in battle, severed t'hose thousand arrows before they could reach him, with fifteen swift-coursing shafts of his.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽर्जुनं शितैर्बाणैर्दशभिर्दशभिः पुनः।  प्राविध्यन्त ततःपार्थस्तानविध्यस्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः॥१३॥
verses.english: Thereat they pierced Arjuna with ten whetted shafts separately; and the son of Pritha also pierced them separately with three shafts each.

verses.sanskrit: एकैकस्तु ततः पार्थं राजन् विव्याध पञ्चभिः।  स च तान् प्रतिविव्याध द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां पराक्रमी॥१४॥
verses.english: Then, O monarch, each of them separately pierced the son of Pritha with five shafts; and the puissant Partha in return pierced them each with a couple of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: भूय एव तु संक्रुद्धास्त्वर्जुनं सह केशवम्।  आपूरयन् शरैस्तीक्ष्णैस्तडागमिव वृष्टिभिः॥१५॥
verses.english: Wrought up with ire, they once again quickly filled Arjuna and Keshava with arrows, like the rains filling up a lake.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शरसहस्राणि प्रापतन्नर्जुनं प्रति।  भ्रमराणामिव व्राताः फुल्लं द्रुमगणं वने॥१६॥
ततः सुबाहुस्त्रिंशद्भिरद्रिसारमयैः शरैः।  अविध्यदिषुभिर्गाढं किरीटे सव्यसाचिनम्॥१७॥
तैः किरीटी किरीटस्थैर्हेमपुङ्खैरजिह्मगैः।  शातकुंभमयापीडो बभौ सूर्य इवोत्थितः॥१८॥
verses.english: Having those straight-going shafts furnished with wings of gold stuck on his diadem, Arjuna, as if adorned with ornaments of gold, shone like the rising Sun.

verses.sanskrit: हस्तावापं सुबाहोस्तु भल्लेन युधि पाण्डवः।  चिच्छेद तं चैव पुनः शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्॥१९॥
verses.english: Then in that battle the son of Pandu, with a broad-headed arrow cut-off the finger-guard of Suvahu and also covered him over with arrowy showers.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुशर्मा दशभिः सुरथस्तु किरीटिनम्।  सुधर्मा सुधनुश्चैव सुबाहुश्च समार्पयत्॥२०॥
verses.english: Thereafter Susarman, Suratha, Sudhaman and Subahu, pierced the diadem decked Arjuna with ten arrows each.

verses.sanskrit: तांस्तु सर्वान् पृथग्बाणैर्वानरप्रवरध्वजः।  प्रत्यविध्यद्ध्वजांश्चैषां भल्लैश्चिच्छेद सायकान्॥२१॥
verses.english: Thereat, that one bearing the foremost of the monkeys as a device on his banner, pierced them all with several arrows in return and he cut down their golden flag-staffs with broadheadedshafts.

verses.sanskrit: सुधन्वनो धनुश्छित्त्वा हयांश्चास्यावधीच्छरैः।  अथास्य सशिरस्त्राणं शिरः कायादपातयत्॥२२॥
verses.english: Having severed the bow of Sudhaman, Arjuna slew his horses with his shafts. Then Arjuna severed from the trunk, the head of the former furnished with a head-gear.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्निपतिते वीरे त्रस्तास्तस्य पदानुगाः। व्यद्रवन्त भयाद्भीता यत्र दौर्योधनं बलम्॥२३॥
verses.english: At the fall of that brave warrior, his followers, were inspired with terror; and seized with panic they ran to where the army of Duryodhana was.

verses.sanskrit: ततो जघान संक्रुद्धो वासविस्तां महाचमूम्। शरजालैरविच्छिन्नैस्तमः सूर्य इवांशुभिः॥२४॥
ततो भग्ने बले तस्मिन् विप्रलीने समंततः।  सव्यसाचिनि संक्रुद्धे त्रैगर्तान् भयमाविशत्॥२५॥
verses.english: When that host was shattered and scattered in all directions and when Savyasachin was inflamed with wrath, panic seized Trigarttas.

verses.sanskrit: ते वध्यमानाः पार्थेन शरैः सन्नतपर्वभिः।  अमुह्यास्तत्र तत्रैव त्रस्ता मृगगणा इव॥२६॥
ततस्त्रिगर्तराट् क्रुद्धस्तानुवाच महारथान्।  अलं द्रुतेन वः शूरानभयं कर्तुमर्हथ॥२७॥
verses.english: Thereupon, excited with rage, the sovereign of the Trigarttas addressing those mighty carwarriors said, 'Fly not, you heroes, it behoves you not to be seized with panic.

verses.sanskrit: शप्त्वाथ शपथान् घोरान्सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः।  गत्वा दौर्योधनं सैन्यं किं वै वक्ष्यथ मुख्यशः॥२८॥
verses.english: Having taken dreadful oaths before the eyes of the entire troops, what shall you say to the leaders of Duryodhana's army if now you go back to them?

verses.sanskrit: नावहास्याः कथं लोके कर्मणानेन संयुगे।  भवेम सहिताः सर्वे निवर्तध्वं यथाबलम्॥२९॥
verses.english: Will we not be the objects of derision in this world, for this (cowardly) act of ours in battle? United together, do you again repair to your own divisions?'

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तास्तु ते राजन्नुदक्रोशन्मुहुर्मुहुः।  शंखांश्च दध्मिरे वीरा हर्षयन्तः परस्परम्॥३०॥
verses.english: Thus being spoken to, O monarch. they uttered continuous roars and those heroes blew their conchs imparting delight to one another.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते संन्यवर्तन्त संशप्तकगणाः पुनः।  नारायणाश्च गोपाला मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम्॥३१॥
verses.english: Thereafter that Samshaptaka host once more rallied themselves; and with the Narayana cow-herds, they were determined even to encounter Death himself.
